item.title: Rallying Cry – May 31, 2026
item.description: Britain’s trains might finally get decent Wi-Fi, Mexico’s World Cup squad secured a last-minute win, thousands of devotees celebrated Vesak Day with a beautiful Buddhist ritual, and a sick musician’s audience stepped in to save the show.
